nodes.label: ardmoreceramics.c.frappe.cloud
nodes.rationale: Moved 2026-07-20 from ardmore.jh.frappe.cloud, which is now dead.

nodes.label: Company Ardmore
nodes.rationale: Agreed 2026-10-13 as the one ERPNext company for go-live; not itself a Sage company.

nodes.label: Company Ardmore Ceramics TEST
nodes.rationale: Kept on purpose through the 2026-10-13 clean-up because the TEST-only lock posts through it and the training tills live there.

nodes.label: Company SageTesting
nodes.rationale: Deleted in the 2026-10-13 go-live clean-up.

nodes.label: Main Distribution - A
nodes.rationale: Single central warehouse; created new because Main - A could not be renamed. Older notes saying Main - A as a warehouse mean this one.

nodes.label: POS Profile Airport
nodes.rationale: Recreated disabled purely to hold the Airport sales rep names; Airport is not in the go-live.

nodes.label: Company Sage Integration
nodes.rationale: Setting custom_default_warehouse is what switches the QOH sync on for a company.

nodes.label: Kiln Sheet Importer - Import
nodes.rationale: A re-import updates details but never adds quantity, because there is only ever one piece.

nodes.label: Home Fashion Importer - Import
nodes.rationale: A re-import still adds the sheet quantity to stock on hand, so the same sheet must never be imported twice.

nodes.label: update-item-add-info
nodes.rationale: Paul's Sept-2025 one-off; disabled but left in place after its target function was removed from the server_scripts app.

nodes.label: POS Voucher Ref
nodes.rationale: v4 prompts only on Complete Order because the POS document keydown listener fed popup keystrokes into the payment amount.

nodes.label: POS Recent Orders Sales Returns
nodes.rationale: Polls and patches any unpatched instance because the POS rebuilds its components each time the cashier re-enters the till.

nodes.label: POS New Invoice From Recent Orders
POS Cart Quantity
nodes.rationale: Typing only, no stepper, so a 20 m fabric sale does not take 20 clicks. Part quantities are refused unless the unit is Meter.

nodes.label: nest_stock_request
nodes.rationale: Built on Material Request and draft Stock Entry rather than the custom Stock Transfer doctype so other clients can use it.

nodes.label: Insights fork (syncflo-custom-theme)
nodes.rationale: Has blocked every deploy twice by drifting from newer Frappe: removed PostHog symbols, then a sqlglot pin.

nodes.label: Item.custom_qty_pending_sage
nodes.rationale: Stops the 5-minute QOH sync wiping locally added stock on existing items, since Pharoh has no quantity update endpoint.

nodes.label: Item.custom_pos_barcode
nodes.rationale: 8-digit sequential number because item codes do not fit a 40 mm label at 203 dpi.

nodes.label: Stock Entry.custom_stock_already_owned
nodes.rationale: Opening-count transfers out of Main Distribution would otherwise invoice stock the receiving entity already owns.

nodes.label: Standard Selling price list (disabled)
nodes.rationale: Russell chose not to enable it; standard_rate must stay empty because filling it writes to this list.

nodes.label: Ardmore Sales - Year on Year dashboard
TEST-only lock (SAGE_FORCE_COMPANY)
nodes.rationale: Forces live-company documents to the Sage testing company until explicitly lifted, by blanking the constant in the three posting scripts.

nodes.label: TRAINING_COMPANIES guard
nodes.rationale: Training must have no Sage connection at all, so training documents are never posted and never flagged Failed for retry.

nodes.label: Store-owner Sage routing
nodes.rationale: Category routing split a store's takings across three Sage companies while the money hit one bank account, and would have invoiced stock Home had already bought twice.

nodes.label: Own-company sync rule
nodes.rationale: The same item exists in all three Sage companies; without this the last company to sync overwrote item-level fields, which produced the random price changes.

nodes.label: Sage owns price after creation
nodes.rationale: A sheet cannot update an existing Sage item because there is no update endpoint, so the sheet prices an item only when it creates it.

nodes.label: Kiln sheet INCL VAT price rules
POS in Sales Invoice mode
nodes.rationale: A tax invoice per sale is mandatory; till sales never reaching Sage had let the QOH sync write sold stock back into Main Distribution.

nodes.label: Item_Cost is valuation authority
nodes.rationale: Sage's valuation_rate was the selling price for some items, valuing stock at retail with zero margin.

nodes.label: No direct Shopify integration
nodes.rationale: By design a person re-captures each online order into ERPNext, which then performs the Sage functions.

nodes.label: Account Sale posts to customer's Sage account
QOH sync sums three Sage companies
nodes.rationale: With all three integrations on one warehouse the last company to run won per item and could zero another entity's stock.

nodes.label: Server Script runtime-only sandbox failures
nodes.rationale: Leading-underscore names, commit in DocType Event scripts and top-level vars inside functions all save cleanly but fail on execution; always run a script once against real data.

nodes.label: Select option mismatch blocks item saves
One bad row poisons a whole batch
Two VAT conventions on one price list
Sheet qty reaches Sage only for new items
Sage documents sent as inclusive
nodes.rationale: Sage rebuilt totals from the rounded exclusive line, so a R150 sale arrived as 149.99.
